name: IGEV++
plain: The successor of IGEV-Stereo by Gangwei Xu et al., with multi-range geometry encoding volumes for large disparity ranges.
summary: IGEV++ (Xu et al. 2025): IGEV-Stereo with geometry encoding volumes for small, medium and large disparity ranges (48 bins each at 1/4 resolution, up to 768 px), aggregated separately and blended per pixel in the ConvGRU update, 32 iterations.

papers.title: IGEV++: Iterative Multi-range Geometry Encoding Volumes for Stereo Matching

limitations: CUDA output (float16, kernels, float32 with PyTorch's default TF32 convolutions) differs from the CPU by ~0.06 px mean / 1.2 px p99 at 720x1280, 0.005 px with full float32: rounding amplified by 32 GRU iterations. Portable and kernels reach the same ETH3D / Middlebury accuracy.
task_io: Input: a rectified left / right image pair. Output: a disparity map (pixels, left view).
